**Finding: compliant** — no non-compete or field-of-use restriction binds Corio.

- **§2.7 (p0042)** is a standard license-scope / no-reverse-engineering restriction tied to the Software and MarketSite.net Service — not a restraint on our business activities.
- **§13.6 (p0117)** affirmatively preserves each party's right to develop independently, which is the carve-out our playbook would otherwise negotiate for.
- **§14.8 (p0131)** confirms Corio solely directs the Corio Services and may subcontract freely.
- The **Territory** (North America, expandable at no cost under §2.10) and **Corio Market Segment** (<$1B customers, with growth/M&A carve-outs in §1.3) limit the scope of the licenses granted *to us*; they do not prohibit us from operating other businesses or licensing competing products, so they are not a field-of-use non-compete on Customer.
- Nothing in §§3, 6, 11–14 or Exhibit D (sales/marketing cooperation, expressly non-binding) imposes exclusivity on Corio.

Meets the preferred position, so no redline was proposed.
